# Steadman Philippon Research Institute

> > Leading orthopaedic research institute in Vail, Colorado, advancing sports medicine, regenerative medicine, and injury prevention through biomedical engineering and clinical research.

Founded by Dr. Richard Steadman, SPRI is globally recognized for pioneering orthopaedic innovations including the microfracture procedure, serving elite athletes and partnering with organizations like the IOC and Team USA. The institute hosts the annual Vail Scientific Summit and conducts cutting-edge research in biomechanics, cellular senescence, and regenerative therapies.

## Key Topics

- Sports Medicine
- Orthopaedic Research
- Regenerative Medicine
- Injury Prevention
- Biomedical Engineering
- ACL Reconstruction
- Rotator Cuff Repair
- Meniscus Repair
- Biomechanics
- Cellular Senescence
- Microfracture Procedure
- Olympic Athlete Care
- Vail Scientific Summit
- The Steadman Clinic
- Dr. Richard Steadman

- [Intra-Articular Knee Effusion Induces Quadriceps Avoidance Gait Patterns](https://www.sprivail.org/departments/biomedical-engineering/intra-articular-knee-effusion-induces-quadriceps-avoidance-gait-patterns): Biomechanics study on knee effusion and quadriceps avoidance gait
- [AJSM August 2017 Podcast: Two-Tunnel Transtibial Repair of Radial Meniscus Tears](https://www.sprivail.org/publications/institute-news/ajsm-august-2017-podcast-two-tunnel-transtibial-repair-of-radial-meniscus-tears-produces-comparable-results-to-inside-out-repair-of-vertical-meniscus-tears): Dr. LaPrade's AJSM podcast on transtibial meniscus repair techniques
